scope.behavior: Deny relation traversal in tenant-scoped read filters, sort, and groupBy until each relation has an explicit organization/location authorization contract.
preserved: Scalar field filters and logical composition

limitations: No live Directus runtime, database, populated rows, or API credentials were used.
This closes source-level relation query oracles in the hook contract; it does not establish effective deployed Directus permissions or populated-data parity.
Nested object filters on JSON fields are rejected as ambiguous; scalar operators such as _contains remain available.
